label: conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5
title: QOU's Hecke-NF + Bring-$S_5$ infrastructure discharges Goncharov's depth-3 conjecture at $F = \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5)$
html:
Conjecture. QOU's Hecke-NF + Bring-S_5 infrastructure discharges Goncharov's depth-3 conjecture at F = \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5)

Conjecture (QOU's Hecke-NF + Bring-S_5 infrastructure discharges Goncharov's depth-3 conjecture at F = \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5)).

The depth-2 identification (prop:depth-2-identification-bloch-suslin) is theorem-level via Bloch–Suslin. The depth-3 case requires Goncharov's motivic conjecture. We propose that QOU's infrastructure discharges Goncharov's conjecture for F = \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5).

Goncharov's conjecture asserts K_5^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} \cong \mathfrak{B}_3(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}, with \mathfrak{B}_3(F) the weight-3 Bloch group modulo the 22-term relation. For F = \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5), Borel gives \dim_\mathbb{Q} K_5^{\mathrm{ind}}(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5)) \otimes \mathbb{Q} = 2. The Goncharov regulator maps this rank-2 space into \mathcal{P}_3 / \mathcal{P}_2 over \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5).

The reduced target for QOU is to prove that \{\mathrm{Li}_3(\zeta_5^k) : k = 1, 2, 3, 4\} modulo the multiplication-formula identity span exactly this rank-2 image, with the only further relation being the Goncharov 22-term restricted to \zeta_5-arguments.

See Table 1.

First route — Jones-coincident pair generation. For each Jones-coincident pair of Bring-embeddable knots (K_1, K_2) with J_{K_1}(q) = J_{K_2}(q) \in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}], we obtain a depth-2 equality \mathrm{Vol}(K_1) = \mathrm{Vol}(K_2) and a depth-3 equality \mathrm{CS}(K_1) = \pm\mathrm{CS}(K_2). Enumerating Jones-coincident pairs yields a generating list of depth-3 relations among CS invariants. If these relations span the kernel of K_5^{\mathrm{ind}}(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5)) \otimes \mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}/\pi^4\mathbb{Q}, then Goncharov's conjecture at \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5) is implied by Hecke NF redundancy.

Second route — direct construction of the 22-term-style relation. We express Goncharov's 22-term relation restricted to z \in \{\zeta_5^k\} as an element G_{22}(\zeta_5) \in \mathbb{Q}\langle \mathrm{Li}_3(\zeta_5), \mathrm{Li}_3(\zeta_5^2), \ldots \rangle that equals 0 modulo \mathcal{P}_2. We find a Hecke element \beta \in H_n(q) such that \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(\mathrm{tr}_M(\beta)) at q \to \zeta_5 equals G_{22}(\zeta_5), and the Hecke NF of \beta reduces to the identity element modulo depth-\leq 2 terms. Then \mathrm{tr}_M(\beta) = 0 \pmod{\text{depth} \leq 2}, so G_{22}(\zeta_5) = 0 in \mathcal{P}_3 / \mathcal{P}_2 by NF reduction alone.

If either route succeeds, we close one specific cyclotomic case.
